lenses.name: Clay shrink-swell
lenses.description: Area-weighted clay shrink-swell exposure index from the official Géorisques/BRGM zoning raster. Low, medium and high classes are weighted ⅓, ⅔ and 1; coverage is metropolitan France outside Paris and values are hex-scale estimates.

lenses.name: Seismic zoning
lenses.description: Area-weighted seismic-zone index from the official French zoning raster. Zones 1–5 are weighted 0.2–1, so values represent average zoning intensity rather than earthquake probability or expected damage.

lenses.name: Radon potential
lenses.description: Population-independent commune radon-potential index from Géorisques/BRGM. Low, moderate and high commune classes are weighted ⅓, ⅔ and 1; values are not indoor measurements.

lenses.name: Forest-fire risk perimeter
lenses.description: Approximate share of hex area inside official forest-fire risk-prevention servitude perimeters. These administrative prevention perimeters indicate regulated exposure areas, not fire probability, vegetation-fuel intensity or expected damage.

lenses.name: Avalanche risk perimeter
lenses.description: Approximate share of hex area inside official avalanche risk-prevention servitude perimeters. These administrative prevention perimeters indicate regulated exposure areas, not avalanche return periods or expected damage.

lenses.name: Ground-movement risk perimeter
lenses.description: Approximate share of hex area inside official ground-movement risk-prevention servitude perimeters. These administrative prevention perimeters indicate regulated exposure areas, not landslide probability, velocity or expected damage.
